```{r}
emb <- Embeddings(MG.recluster.obj, "nmf_umap")
x <- emb[, 1]
y <- emb[, 2]

xmin <- min(x)
xmax <- max(x)
ymin <- min(y)
ymax <- max(y)

xrange <- xmax - xmin
yrange <- ymax - ymin

# 左下角短轴
axis_df <- data.frame(
  x = c(xmin, xmin, xmin, xmin + 0.12 * xrange),
  y = c(ymin, ymin + 0.12 * yrange, ymin, ymin),
  group = c(1, 1, 2, 2)
)

# 轴标签
label_df <- data.frame(
  x = c(xmin - 0.06 * xrange, xmin + 0.10 * xrange),
  y = c(ymin + 0.08 * yrange, ymin - 0.06 * yrange),
  label = c("UMAP2", "UMAP1"),
  angle = c(90, 0)
)

axes_conner <- function(p){ 
  p + 
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    xlab(NULL) +
    ylab(NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank()
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = axis_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = group),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      color = "black",
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "in"), ends = "last", type = "open")
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = label_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, angle = angle),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2,
      color = "black"
    )
}
```

```{r}
Idents(MG.recluster.obj) <- "state_anno_compare"
state.pathway.markers <- FindAllMarkers(MG.recluster.obj,only.pos = T)
state.pathway.markers$pct.diff <- state.pathway.markers$pct.1 - state.pathway.markers$pct.2
state.pathway.markers.sig <- state.pathway.markers[state.pathway.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05,]
state.pathway.markers.sig.pct <- state.pathway.markers.sig[state.pathway.markers.sig$pct.diff > 0.3,]
```

```{r}
top_pathways <- state.pathway.markers.sig.pct %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct.diff), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    n_keep <- ifelse(unique(.y$cluster) == "Control", 6, 3)
    slice_head(.x, n = n_keep)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


feature_color_df <- top_pathways %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cluster) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

top_features.filt <- feature_color_df$gene

vlnt.marker.color <- state_colors[as.character(feature_color_df$cluster)]
vlnt.marker.color.unfilt[is.na(vlnt.marker.color.unfilt)] <- "#F8766D"
names(vlnt.marker.color) <- feature_color_df$gene

pdf("./Figure_Final/Vlnplot_filter_feature.pdf",
    width = 14, height = 8)

VlnPlot(
  MG.recluster.obj,
  group.by  = "state_anno",
  features  = top_features.filt,
  stack     = TRUE,
  flip      = TRUE,
  fill.by   = "feature",
  cols      = vlnt.marker.color,
) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.right = element_text(
      hjust = 0,
      face  = "bold",
      size  = 14
    )
  )

dev.off()
```



```{r}
# Plot cell fraction
dat_frac <- as.data.frame(table(MG.recluster.obj$time_condition, MG.recluster.obj$state_anno))
count <- tapply(dat_frac$Freq, dat_frac$Var2, sum)
dat_frac$fraction <- dat_frac$Freq / rep(count, each = 4)
dat_frac$Var1 <- factor(dat_frac$Var1, levels = c("Acute Control", "Acute Disease", 
                                                  "Chronic Control", "Chronic Disease"))
dat_frac$Var2 <- factor(dat_frac$Var2, levels = levels(MG.recluster.obj$state_anno))

p2 <- ggplot(dat_frac, aes(x = Var2, y = fraction, fill = Var1)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  xlab("") + ylab("Fraction of cells") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) #+
  # scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = group_colors)

pdf("p2.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)

print(p2)

dev.off()

```

```{r}
library(ggpattern)

# 背景色:按 dataset 区分(Acute / Chronic)

  "Acute Control"   = "#0072B2",
  "Acute Disease"   = "#0072B2",
  "Chronic Control" = "#E69F00",

)

pattern_fill_cols <- c(
  "Acute Control"   = "#B1A9E5",
  "Acute Disease"   = "#6A5ACD",
  "Chronic Control" = "#B1A9E5",
  "Chronic Disease" = "#6A5ACD"
)

p3 <- ggplot(dat_frac, aes(x = Var2, y = fraction,
                           fill = Var1, pattern_fill = Var1)) +
  geom_col_pattern(
    pattern         = "stripe",
    pattern_angle   = 45,     # 斜纹角度
    pattern_density = 0.5,    # 0.5 = 两色各占一半,交错最均匀
    pattern_spacing = 0.02,   # 条纹间距,越小条纹越密
    pattern_colour  = NA,     # 去掉条纹边线
    colour          = NA      # 去掉柱子边线
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Var1", values = fill_cols) +
  scale_pattern_fill_manual(name = "Var1", values = pattern_fill_cols) +
  xlab("") + ylab("Fraction of cells") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))
```

```{r}
library(msigdbr)
```



```{r total gene sets}
## =========================================================
## Mouse-native MSigDB gene sets (db_species = "MM")
##   - MH  : mouse Hallmark (mouse-native)
##   - M5  : mouse GO (we'll take GO:BP and filter size)
##   - M7  : mouse Immunologic signatures
## Optional:
##   - M8  : mouse cell-type signatures (identity; usually NOT for "state")
## Notes:
##   * Reactome / KEGG / WikiPathways are NOT mouse-native in MSigDB.
##     Those live under human C2 and require ortholog mapping.
## =========================================================

## -------------------------
## Tier 1 (mouse-native)
##   - MH (Hallmark)
## -------------------------
m_mh <- msigdbr(category   = "MH", species  = "mouse", db_species = "MM")
genesets_MH <- split(m_mh$gene_symbol, m_mh$gs_name)


# 2) Reactome pathways
m_mreactome <- msigdbr(species = "mouse", category = "M2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME", db_species = "MM")
genesets_M2_REACTOME <- split(m_mreactome$gene_symbol, m_mreactome$gs_name)

# 3) WikiPath pathways
m_mwiki <- msigdbr(species = "mouse", category = "M2", subcategory = "CP:WIKIPATHWAYS", db_species = "MM")
genesets_M2_WIKI <- split(m_mwiki$gene_symbol, m_mwiki$gs_name)


genesets_tier1_mouse <- c(genesets_MH,genesets_M2_REACTOME,genesets_M2_WIKI)

## -------------------------
## Tier 2 (mouse-native)
##   - M7 (Immunologic)
##   - M5:GO:BP (filtered by size)
## -------------------------

# M7: Immunologic signatures (FULL)
m_m7 <- msigdbr(species = "mouse",category   = "M7", db_species = "MM")
genesets_M7_all <- split(m_m7$gene_symbol, m_m7$gs_name)

# M5: GO Biological Process (GO:BP), then size-filter
m_m5_gobp <- msigdbr(species = "mouse",category = "M5", subcollection = "GO:BP", db_species = "MM")

m_m5_gobp_filt <- m_m5_gobp %>%
  group_by(gs_name) %>%
  filter(dplyr::n() >= 20 & dplyr::n() <= 200) %>%
  ungroup()

genesets_M5_GO_BP_filtered <- split(m_m5_gobp_filt$gene_symbol, m_m5_gobp_filt$gs_name)

genesets_tier2_mouse <- c(genesets_M7_all, genesets_M5_GO_BP_filtered)


## -------------------------
## Final (mouse-native)
## -------------------------
genesets_mouse_final <- c(genesets_tier1_mouse, genesets_tier2_mouse)

```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# STEP 1: Extract AUCell matrix and align gene sets
# =============================================================================
 
# Pull pathway x cell matrix from the AUCell assay
auc_mat <- tryCatch(
  GetAssayData(MG.recluster.obj, assay = "AUCell", layer = "data"),   # Seurat v5
  error = function(e)
    GetAssayData(MG.recluster.obj, assay = "AUCell", slot  = "data")  # Seurat v4
)

auc_pathways <- rownames(auc_mat)

# --- Harmonise naming: replace "_" with "-" in genesets names ---
# AUCell uses "-" as separator; msigdbr uses "_"
names(genesets_mouse_final) <- gsub("_", "-", names(genesets_mouse_final))

# Keep only gene sets present in both
common_terms <- intersect(auc_pathways, names(genesets_mouse_final))

cat(sprintf("AUCell pathways        : %d\n", length(auc_pathways)))
cat(sprintf("genesets_mouse_final   : %d\n", length(genesets_mouse_final)))
cat(sprintf("Matched common terms   : %d\n", length(common_terms)))

n_missing <- length(auc_pathways) - length(common_terms)
if (n_missing > 0)
  warning(sprintf(
    "%d AUCell pathways still unmatched after name harmonisation.",
    n_missing))

# Subset both objects to matched terms only
genesets_auc <- genesets_mouse_final[common_terms]
auc_mat      <- auc_mat[common_terms, ]
```

```{r}
selected_pathways <- unique(parent_terms_df$parentTerm)
matrix_data <- as.matrix(MG.recluster.obj[["AUCell"]]$data[selected_pathways, ])

# correlation
cor_matrix <- cor(t(matrix_data))

# 准备注释和颜色
regime_info <- parent_terms_df
regime_colors <- state_colors



# 关键：把 -0.5 到 0.5 压成白色区域
# col_fun <- colorRamp2(
#   c(-1, -0.3, 0, 0.3, 1),
#   c("blue", "white", "grey","white", "red")
# )

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
  c("blue", "white", "white","white", "red")
)

# col_fun <- colorRamp2(
#   c(-1, 0, 1),
#   c("blue", "white", "red")
# )

# 绘制热图
h_reduced <- Heatmap(cor_matrix, 
        name = "Correlation",
        col = col_fun,
        column_split = regime_info$cluster, 
        row_split = regime_info$cluster,
        cluster_row_slices = FALSE, 
        cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
        top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(State = regime_info$cluster, col = list(State = regime_colors)),
        left_annotation = rowAnnotation(State = regime_info$cluster, col = list(State = regime_colors)),
        column_title = "Reduced AUCell Functional Modules",
        show_row_names = FALSE, 
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        use_raster = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

states <- c("State1", "State2", "State3", "State4", "State5")

# 每个 State 只保留约简后的代表(parent) term —— 每个冗余组一行
parent_terms_df <- bind_rows(lapply(states, function(stte) {
  get(paste("reduced_by", stte, sep = "_")) %>%
    filter(term == parentTerm) %>%        # 代表行：term 等于自己的 parentTerm
    distinct(term, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # 防御性去重（组内不应有重复）
    transmute(term, parentTerm, group, size, score, cluster = stte)
}))

write.csv(parent_terms_df, file = "MAY.parent_terms_df.MG.csv")
```


```{r}
# 1) 确保代表通路都在 AUCell 矩阵里（避免按行名取子集时报错/产生 NA 行）
available <- rownames(MG.recluster.obj[["AUCell"]]$data)
missing   <- setdiff(unique(parent_terms_df$term), available)
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  warning(sprintf("%d 条通路不在 AUCell data 中，已剔除：%s",
                  length(missing), paste(head(missing, 5), collapse = ", ")))
  parent_terms_df <- parent_terms_df[parent_terms_df$term %in% available, ]
}

selected_pathways <- parent_terms_df$term
matrix_data <- as.matrix(MG.recluster.obj[["AUCell"]]$data[selected_pathways, , drop = FALSE])

# 2) 通路 × 通路 的相关性（在细胞维度上）
cor_matrix <- cor(t(matrix_data))

# 3) 注释与配色，按行与 parent_terms_df 一一对应
regime_info   <- parent_terms_df
regime_colors <- state_colors

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
  c("blue", "white", "white", "white", "red")
)

h_reduced <- Heatmap(
  cor_matrix,
  name                  = "Correlation",
  col                   = col_fun,
  column_split          = regime_info$cluster,
  row_split             = regime_info$cluster,
  cluster_row_slices    = FALSE,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  top_annotation  = HeatmapAnnotation(State = regime_info$cluster,
                                      col = list(State = regime_colors)),
  left_annotation = rowAnnotation(State = regime_info$cluster,
                                  col = list(State = regime_colors)),
  column_title      = "Reduced AUCell Functional Modules",
  show_row_names    = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  use_raster        = TRUE
)

pdf("./Figure_Final/cor0.5_reduced_marker_htmp.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
draw(h_reduced)
dev.off()
```
